## Round Sparky values to two decimal places

This patch release prevents internal binary floating-point digits from appearing
in SparkyFitness custom-measurement fields.

- All seven numeric values are rounded to at most two decimal places only when
  the outgoing Sparky API request is built.
- GARLYN calculations, Home Assistant entities and history, and values held in
  the persistent outbox retain their original precision.
- The three custom records remain `source: manual`; the four native records keep
  `GARLYN Scale via Home Assistant`.
- Field types, units, timestamps, daily coalescing, retry behavior, and strict
  seven-record response validation are unchanged.
- Previously delivered Sparky records are not rewritten. Rounding applies to
  measurements delivered after this update.

This is a Home Assistant-only update. The ESPHome component and transport
protocol are unchanged, so the ESP does not need to be reflashed.
